name: Ceph
description: Reads a Ceph cluster's pools and RBD images through the manager's REST API, so the graph can say which customer's workload is on which pool and how near it is to full.

config.label: Ceph manager address
config.hint: Where the dashboard API answers, for example https://ceph-mgr.dc2.example.com:8443. The management address, not a client one.

config.label: Verify the certificate
config.hint: Turn this off only for a cluster using its own self-signed certificate on a management network you control.

config.label: Timeout (seconds)
config.hint: A cluster that is recovering answers slowly, and an inventory read must not become an operator staring at a spinner.
